name: Branching Quests
description: Four questlines with real choices and multiple endings, where NPCs react to the side you pick. THE SECRET MAP: give a sailor's map to the Saffron scientist (rare TM) or the Fuchsia gambler (gold). THE POACHER'S BARGAIN: recover the amber shard for a Cerulean researcher, or take the poacher's bribe. THE SILPH WHISTLEBLOWER: a multi-step investigation across Saffron, Celadon, and Vermilion - gather two clues, then expose the company or sell your silence. TWO BROTHERS: settle a Celadon feud and pick a side. Custom key items, flag-driven consequence dialogue. No engine files touched, no maps edited.
